description: North Western Provincial Council - Notice the order under Provincial Environmental Statute to prohibit the activities on polythene
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory matters under the Provincial Environmental Statute No. 12 of 1990, specifically orders prohibiting the manufacture, sale, and use of certain polythene products within the North Western Province. It establishes legal prohibitions and exemptions, defines terms, and rescinds previous orders, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
